style: 3D animation, original character design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast

props: the fox's big red stamp on a long handle, prints a red paw print; ONE gold key: his paws 0-0.6, nail over the door 0.6-9.2, her ring of twenty identical gold keys 9.2-10, red print from 0.3; his honey jar; her straw; his striped pillow; his copper clock on a stump
